hints.title: Minimum Frequency Intersection
hints.text: A character appears in all strings only as many times as its minimum occurrence count across every individual string.

hints.title: Counting Per Word
hints.text: Calculate the 26-letter frequency histogram for each word. Maintain a global minimum histogram updated by taking the minimum count for each letter.

hints.title: Result Expansion
hints.text: Initialize the minimum count array with frequencies from the first word. For each subsequent word, take the elementwise minimum. Finally append each character as many times as its final count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise string replacements or scans without frequency histograms result in excessive string recreation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed-size 26-element integer buffers take constant auxiliary space and linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that character counts across multiple words require the multiset intersection / elementwise minimum.
complexity.notes: Alphabet size is constant at 26 lowercase English letters.
